pages.text: $(l:damageoverhaul:config/config_overview)ranged_config.json$() manages ranged damage: global default source (weapon/projectile), per-projectile $(bold)follow_default$() switch and distributions. Dual-purpose items (trident) default to refusing the global default.

$(2)Item-entity mapping$()$(br)Tipped arrows share minecraft:arrow. Resolution order: 1) same-ID match, 2) tag scan (minecraft:arrows / forge:arrows), 3) manual entries in $(l:damageoverhaul:config/config_overview)projectile_item_mappings.json$().
